title: Boutique Hotel Lounge Layout Planner
description: The user designs a boutique hotel lounge corner by positioning ornate damask chairs and a commercial refrigerator bar unit within a floor-plan grid. They must snap furniture to valid grid cells, rotate pieces to face a focal point, adjust ambient and accent lighting, toggle between day and night modes, and finalize the layout by validating spacing and orientation constraints.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a boutique hotel lounge layout planner. Load ChairDamaskPurplegold.glb and CommercialRefrigerator.glb using GLTFLoader. Scene setup: render a 10x10 grid floor made of subtle marble-textured plane tiles (use procedural checkerboard material). Place walls on two sides as thin box geometries with a warm plaster color to suggest a room corner. Add a hemisphere light for ambient fill and a movable SpotLight for accent lighting. Camera: use OrbitControls with constrained polar angle (15-75 degrees) and a default isometric-like perspective. Interactions (minimum 8 validated steps): 1) Click a grid cell to place the refrigerator, snapping to cell center. Validate it is placed against a wall edge. 2) Click another grid cell to place the first chair. Validate minimum 2-cell distance from the refrigerator. 3) Place a second chair instance on a different valid cell with the same distance constraint. 4) Select any placed furniture and press R to rotate it 90 degrees. Validate that chairs face toward the room center, not into walls. 5) Use a slider in an HTML overlay panel to adjust the SpotLight intensity from 0.2 to 3.0 and reposition it by dragging a helper sphere. 6) Toggle a Day/Night button that switches the hemisphere light between warm white and dim blue and changes the floor material tone. 7) Press a Validate Layout button that checks all constraints: refrigerator against wall, chairs facing center, minimum spacing met, and accent light within bounds. Display pass/fail per rule in a results panel. 8) Click Finalize to lock all positions, disable dragging, and play a short camera tween (using TWEEN or manual lerp) that orbits 360 degrees around the layout as a showcase. Highlight selected objects with an emissive outline. Show a small HUD with step instructions. All parameters must be validated before allowing the next step.
